'''Chandrilan''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] that originated with the [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the language was considered to be ancient and was only spoken by scholars. In Chandrilan, the words ''chandra'' and ''chandrakant'' roughly translated to "point" and "counterpoint" and were used as the names of Chandrila's [[Chandra/Legends|two]] [[Chandrakant/Legends|moons]].<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
